# retro-cookie-banner

> Free, open-source cookie consent banner (GDPR cookie popup) in a single HTML file. Vanilla JavaScript, zero dependencies, retro/brutalist style. Detects the browser language and ships nine languages: English, German, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Finnish, Estonian, Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong), Simplified Chinese (Singapore). Accept all, deny all, or choose categories (necessary, personalisation, statistics, marketing). Keyboard-accessible, stores the choice as JSON in localStorage, shows itself once. MIT licence.

Author: Abbey Lubber. Repository: https://github.com/AbbeyLubber/retro-cookie-banner

## Key facts

- One file: `index.html` contains the CSS, markup and script. No framework, no build step, no external requests.
- Integration: copy the `<style>` block, the `<div class="cookie-overlay">` markup and the `<script>` block into any page.
- Consent record: `localStorage['retroCookieBanner.consent']` = `{"schemaVersion":2,"policyVersion":null,"updatedAt":ISO,"expiresAt":ISO,"categories":{"necessary":true,"personalization":bool,"statistics":bool,"marketing":bool}}`. Expires after 182 days by default; a record with another schema or policy version, an expired date or a non-boolean category is ignored and the banner asks again. Falls back to sessionStorage, then memory.
- API: `window.RetroCookie` with `getConsent()`, `open()`, `close()`, `acceptAll()`, `rejectAll()`, `update({...})`, `reset()`, `version`. Events on `document`: `cookieconsent:ready`, `cookieconsent:change` (detail: `consent`, `categories`, `previous`).
- Script gating: `<script type="text/plain" data-cookie-category="statistics" data-src="...">` (or inline code) runs once its category is allowed.
- Configuration: `window.RetroCookieConfig` defined before the script: `storageKey`, `policyVersion`, `expiryDays`, `lang`, `urls` (learnMore, privacy, terms, thirdParties, optOut), `texts` (per-language overrides).
- Language detection: `navigator.languages`, first match wins; unknown locales fall back to English. Force with `?lang=xx-XX`.
- Accessibility: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `role="switch"`, focus trap, visible focus rings, `prefers-reduced-motion`, ON/OFF text inside toggles so state is readable without colour.
- Responsive from 320 px phones to TV screens.
- Encoding: UTF-8 with BOM so the banner survives a wrong server charset.
- CSP: inline blocks need a nonce (or 'unsafe-inline'); gated scripts pass their nonce to the live script. A `<noscript>` notice covers visitors without JavaScript.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://abbeylubber.github.io/retro-cookie-banner/): the banner on a demo page; add `?lang=de-DE`, `?lang=ru-RU`, `?lang=uk-UA`, `?lang=be-BY`, `?lang=fi-FI`, `?lang=et-EE`, `?lang=zh-HK` or `?lang=zh-SG` for other languages.
- [README](https://github.com/AbbeyLubber/retro-cookie-banner#readme): features, usage, customisation, adding a language, FAQ, comparison with other cookie consent libraries.
- [Source file](https://github.com/AbbeyLubber/retro-cookie-banner/blob/main/banner/index.html): the banner itself.
- [Licence](https://github.com/AbbeyLubber/retro-cookie-banner/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT.
